sloka: विश्वामित्रम् पूजयन् ततः संध्या प्रवर्तते ।ततो मुनिवरः प्रीतः ताटका वध तोषितः ॥१-२६-३२॥
transliteration: viśvāmitram pūjayan tataḥ saṁdhyā pravartate ।tato munivaraḥ prītaḥ tāṭakā vadha toṣitaḥ ॥1-26-32॥

translations.english: Then, the best of ascetics Viswamitra rejoiced over the death of Tataka, kissed the forehead of Rama (fondly) and spoke these words:
